name: Dream Date
source:
You’re on a trip to Paris, feeling lonely when your friend cancelled last minute. In the spur of the moment, you wish upon a star for someone to spend time in the city with and to your surprise—your wish comes true!

Célestin, a wishing star come to life, takes you on a whirlwind of a first date across Paris in this fully voice acted short-and-sweet game.

[From [url=https://skywritestudios.itch.io/dream-date]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你正在去巴黎旅行，当你的朋友在最后一刻取消预订时，你感到孤独。一时冲动，你向一颗星星许愿，希望有人能在这座城市共度美好时光，令你惊讶的是——你的愿望成真了！

在这款全配音的简短而甜蜜的游戏中，塞莱斯廷 (Célestin) 是一位栩栩如生的许愿星，将带你踏上巴黎的第一次约会旋风。

[来自[url=https://skywritestudios.itch.io/dream-date]Itch.io[/url]]
